localFacts.fact: CBS: Dutch men aged 19 were on average 182,9 cm tall in 2020, women 169,3 cm. Replaces the CDC US averages in the eye-level section.

KLM: hand baggage, including handles and wheels, max. 55 x 35 x 25 cm. The Sirui (33 cm), Peak Design (39,4 cm) and Befree Advanced (40 cm) fit inside lengthwise; the Manfrotto 190XPRO kit (70,5 cm) and the Vanguard (about 72 cm) do not.
Rijksmuseum: visitors may photograph and film without disturbing others; for bridal photography the museum explicitly states "geen statieven en geen extra belichting".

Zoom Academy (Zoom.nl) on group portraits: put the camera on a tripod, choose an aperture that keeps front and back row sharp, focus manually at a point about a third into the group and check the first frame zoomed in on the display.
Dutch terms: balhoofd/kogelkop (ball head), middenkolom, zelfontspanner (self-timer), afstandsbediening (remote), intervalopnames, snelkoppelingsplaat; Arca-Swiss keeps its name.

localPainPoints.pain: Unsure whether a tripod strapped to the backpack is allowed as hand baggage when flying with the family.
localPainPoints.fix: Pick a tripod that folds to 33-40 cm so it fits inside a KLM cabin bag (55 x 35 x 25 cm); a full-size kit (70,5 cm) goes in the hold. Check with the airline before flying.

quotes.text: Weet iemand toevallig of ik dat ding gewoon aan m'n rugzak gebonden als handbagage mee kan nemen?

localPainPoints.pain: Security or airline staff can refuse a tripod in the cabin on one leg of the trip.
localPainPoints.fix: Keep the tripod inside the bag, not strapped outside, or check it in; the travel picks fit in a suitcase easily.

quotes.text: Heb met Ryanair gevlogen, de heenweg was geen probleem, de terugweg absoluut wel! Moest het ruim in dus.

localGain.point: Eye-level targets recomputed for Dutch heights (CBS, 19-year-olds: men 182,9 cm, women 169,3 cm): women about 139 to 144 cm on the legs, men about 153 to 158 cm. Column down, only the Manfrotto (146,5 cm) clears the women's target and the Vanguard (about 141 cm) lands inside it; Peak Design (130,2 cm) and Befree (128 cm) fall about 9 to 16 cm short; no pick reaches the men's target, so tall Dutch fathers raise the column a little or use the screen.
KLM hand baggage 55 x 35 x 25 cm: only the three travel tripods fit inside.
Zoom Academy's manual focus tip for group photos backs the focus-lock step.
Maker metric figures instead of conversions.
